context: A boss reviews a CSR risk note
purpose: Teach: ウォン/創価学会/オウム/カルト/伝道/先住民/繁殖/部位

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員勧誘の事例、創価学会と関連を疑う問い合わせがあった。
lines.en: We've received inquiries about staff recruitment cases—specifically questioning possible links to Soka-Gakkai.
lines.style: Measured opening. Slight weight on the concern, but controlled. Voice level steady. Boss-to-subordinate briefing tone, not alarm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。慎重に対応します。過去のオウム事件、カルト対策の参考にしています。
lines.en: Understood. We're handling it carefully, using lessons from the Aum incident and standard cult-risk protocols.
lines.style: Composed, methodical. Slight nod in the voice on 'understood.' Professional assurance—shows he's already thinking through precedent. Calm, capable delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 地域貢献部門の伝道風活動、先住民コミュニティとの接点、慎重に。
lines.en: The community-aid division's outreach activities need scrutiny too—especially any contact with indigenous communities. Proceed with caution.
lines.style: Firmer direction now. Boss clarifying scope. Not a suggestion. Weight on 'caution.' Measured but unmissable authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 繁殖管理事業部位とも、共有しています。
lines.en: Understood. We've already briefed the business-operations teams on this.
lines.style: Quiet confirmation. No defensiveness, just competence. Clean, efficient. Shows initiative without overstating.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 海外決済、ウォン建て案件、リスクを再確認。
lines.en: And overseas transactions—especially Won-denominated deals. Re-check all risk assessments.
lines.style: Closing directive, decisive. Short rhythm. Final note of authority. The weight of closure in his voice.
